name: Kaga Isamu
source:
The central character in this tale, Isamu, is currently pursuing his education as a college student. He embodies strength, possesses a kind and just heart, and is driven by a deep sense of righteousness.

Tragedy struck Isamu's life when he was just a child, as he tragically lost his parents. Left with no one to turn to, he found solace in the embrace of an orphanage, where he spent his formative years.

However, fate took an unexpected turn when he crossed paths with Mayuko, and in a pivotal moment, he became her savior. This act of heroism led to an extraordinary change in both their lives, as Mayuko chose to adopt him. In this newfound family dynamic, Mayuko's care transcended the conventional boundaries of foster parenthood, and she embraced Isamu as her own son.

Isamu's deep affection for Mayuko grew over the years, cementing their unique bond. His dedication to her safety and well-being drove him to master the art of swordsmanship, ensuring he could protect the woman who had become his pillar of strength.

As time passed and Isamu matured, he found himself viewing Mayuko not only as a mother but also as a woman. These new emotions often stirred excitement within him, adding an intriguing layer to their evolving relationship.
